rationale: P characterises whether braking is required and whether the required maneuver occurs in time—the relationship needed to evaluate omission under SG-1. H-1 and FR-7 establish collision-avoiding braking itself as part of the phenomenon, so including braking response and its timeliness is justified. The scope references detection and decision-making as context without incorporating their internal mechanisms or processing deadlines into P.
determining_elements: “Whether a braking maneuver is required” directly addresses the prerequisite for an omission under SG-1.
“Whether braking is performed in time to avoid collision” is supported by H-1's failure-to-stop-in-time hazardous event and FR-7's required collision-avoiding braking.
Obstacle encounters involving road users or objects in the path or close to the trajectory are supported by H-1 and FR-7.2.4.
The scope's detection and braking-decision references do not expand P into sensor operation, computation, communication, or mechanism-level timing.
